article.title: French protests continue on multiple issues
article.author: Editor
article.content: For the fifth consecutive Saturday students, inter-union members, teachers, “gilets jaunes” (yellow vests), parents and other concerned citizens took to the streets to protest economic, social issues, AI, and child endangerment in three marches that converged at the Place de la République before the combined groups marched through the city via the Place de la Bastille, ending at the Place de la Nation. The post French protests continue on multiple issues appeared first on MR Online .
